common_misconceptions: Assuming that an atypical or mild presentation rules out Rhinophyma Surgical Debulking.
Relying solely on a single normal laboratory value or imaging result to prematurely exclude pathology.

dangerous_errors: Failing to recognize red-flag features and delaying urgent escalation or emergency intervention.

Missing a suspicious, ulcerated, rapidly changing, or bleeding lesion that needs biopsy to exclude malignancy.
